event.title: Kushner and Jeffries Meet Ahead of Midterm Elections
event.canonical_title: Kushner and Jeffries Meet Ahead of Midterm Elections
event.summary: Jared Kushner met with Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries in New York City to discuss potential cooperation between Democrats and Trump as the midterm elections approach. The meeting comes as control of the House is at stake in the upcoming November elections, with Democrats expected to gain an advantage. Topics discussed included housing, immigration, and the rising cost of living.

event_overview.title: About Midterm Elections
event_overview.subject: Midterm Elections
event_overview.summary: U.S. midterm elections are the regularly scheduled federal elections held in even-numbered years when no presidential election is on the ballot, choosing members of Congress and often coinciding with state and local contests. The 2026 general election is scheduled for November 3, with all House seats and one of the Senate’s three election classes at issue.

facts.label: Date
facts.value: The next regularly scheduled federal general election is Tuesday, November 3, 2026; federal law sets House elections for the Tuesday after the first Monday in November in every even-numbered year.

facts.label: House elections
facts.value: All 435 voting seats in the U.S. House of Representatives are contested every two years; representatives serve two-year terms.

facts.label: Senate elections
facts.value: Senators serve six-year terms divided into three classes, so approximately one-third of the Senate stands for election or reelection every two years.

facts.label: Election administration
facts.value: Federal elections are administered primarily under state law, commonly by county or other local election authorities, subject to applicable federal requirements.

facts.label: Campaign-finance oversight
facts.value: The Federal Election Commission administers and enforces federal campaign-finance law for House and Senate campaigns, including disclosure rules and contribution and expenditure restrictions.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers particular political events and campaign-related developments connected to the midterms, not every federal, state, or local race, ballot measure, administrative process, or result.
